samples: SyntaxError: Identifier 'value' has already been declared
what: The same scope already has a declaration named `{1}`. JavaScript does not allow two `let`, `const`, or `var` declarations with the same name in one scope.

street.headline: You declare `{1}` two times
street.happen: You don already use the name `{1}` for another thing. Two things no fit carry the same name for the same place.
street.todo: Rename one of them, or delete the extra line.
street.learn: To "declare" na to create a variable with `let`, `const` or `var`.
